verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly shows a built-in "Canva AI" that users can feed pasted links to "design with more context" (canva-docs-10). Natural-language design generation and editing are documented, but through the MCP server for external AI assistants rather than inside the editor (canva-docs-33, canva-docs-18). Missing for 10: evidence of in-editor image generation, background removal, content-aware fill, and copy/text suggestions, plus any first-party product docs or hands-on corroboration of the editor's AI features.
